newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Moslem bomber says loves soccer more than hates Jews.
newsitem.headline: Moslem bomber says loves soccer more than hates Jews.

text.p: One Palestinian would-be suicide bomber said his hatred of "Zionist unbelievers" was tempered only by his love of soccer.

Rashid Saqqer, a Hamas Islamic militant the PLO said it captured last year before he could carry out a suicide bombing in Israel, said in the course of an interview he was an avid fan of Israeli soccer.
Asked by Israel's Channel Two television whether he could carry out an order to detonate himself during a soccer match, Saqqer said: "I couldn't do it in a soccer stadium."
"Yes, they are Zionists...also unbelievers. But I couldn't do it," Saqqer, eyes lowered, told the television.
Hamas, an opponent of Israeli-PLO peace deals, spearheaded a a wave of suicide attacks that killed scores in the Jewish state last year.
